body.intent: Review roles get afk's shipit/forge prompts in Rhiza's words, one guide topic each on the six-section skeleton: compliance (absorbing the scope check: under-built, scope creep, unaccounted files), quality (impact radius, checklist), qa (clean state, scratch build outside PATH, happy and failure cases), model, critic, fixer, ci-fix, gate-fix and conflict-fix; checks are isolated from build history; the scope check leaves review.toml. Source: prompt-gap.md sections 2.5-2.8 and 5 (CS1, CS8).
body.title: Review role topics
